items.title: 商汤开源27B机器人操作模型SenseNova-RoboRSI-27B，RoboDojo得分34.7超GPT-6 Astra
items.originalTitle: 27B小模型机器人考试34.7分，真超了GPT-6？ 27B小模型机器人考试34.7分，真超了GPT-6？ 11月25日，商汤开源了机器人操作模型SenseNova-RoboRSI-27B：27B的体量，权重和训练工具一起放出来，Apache 2.0协议，谁都能下载。在机器人操作考试RoboDojo上，它拿了34.7分，比预览版的10分翻了3.47倍，超过了榜单上GPT-6 Astra的27.6分；商汤用同一套工具测，GPT-6.1 Sol是33.7分，也被它超了。它的办法是让模型自己选：顺着感觉走的连续动作交给VLA，要算得清清楚楚的精确调整就现场写代码。训练只用了仿真数据，没用真实机器人数据，但同一份权重搬上真机械臂，摆盘子十次成六次，叠积木十次成九次，还解开了一个二阶魔方。局限也要说清：34.7分是仿真里的进度分，不是真机成功率；分数是商汤自己报的，复现脚本还没放出来，第三方还没验证；十次试验样本还小。机器人大脑正在变便宜、变开放，但它能不能真进工厂，还得看接下来几个月的实测。 来源：SenseNova 官方技术博客；SenseNova-RoboRSI-27B 官方模型卡；IT之家。
items.summary: 11月25日，商汤开源机器人操作模型SenseNova-RoboRSI-27B，27B体量，权重和训练工具一并放出，采用Apache 2.0协议。该模型在机器人操作考试RoboDojo上得34.7分，是预览版10分的3.47倍，超过榜单上GPT-6 Astra的27.6分，商汤用同一套工具测得GPT-6.1 Sol为33.7分。

items.summary: 四川省人工智能研究院技术转化部部长冷君宁解读AI画不出13个鸡蛋，称文生图大模型学的是海量图片里的风格、构图和物体排布，不会像人一样逐个清点数量，训练数据中蛋托多为12枚、15枚等常规规格，13个属于非常规组合。记者用同一指令实测豆包、元宝、文心一言和千问，豆包首次画出15个、多次修改后数量仍不正确，元宝一次生成4张图无一正确，文心一言也未生成正确图片，只有千问一次性正确生成指定图片。

items.title: 开发者用三个 MiniCPM 模型搭建本地记账 Agent，可自检纠错
items.originalTitle: You snap a photo of a receipt and ask AI to update your ledger. But what if it misreads an item, misses a digit, or gets the total wrong? 🧾 Community developer @DogukanUrker built a local bookkeeping agent that checks its own work using three MiniCPM models. 🧠 MiniCPM-V 4.7 decides where to look and what to verify. 👀 MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 reads individual receipt regions. 🔍 MiniCPM-OCR Jev scores each reading and helps identify better candidates. In one real test, the agent misread "COCONUT JELLY" as "COCONUT SLEET." Jev gave it a score of just 0.29, prompting the agent to zoom in and read again — successfully correcting the error. The agent also checks the math and flags uncertain fields for human review. On degraded CORD-v2 receipts, all 60 totals accepted without a review flag were correct. And your financial documents? They never need to leave your device. All three models run locally on a single RTX 3060, using just 10.2GB of VRAM.🤗 💻 GitHub: https://t.co/msjm2QlrvX https://t.co/2
items.summary: 社区开发者 DogukanUrker 用三个 MiniCPM 模型搭建了一个本地记账 Agent，能对收据识别结果自检并纠错。其中 MiniCPM-V 4.7 决定看哪里、验证什么，MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 读取收据局部区域，MiniCPM-OCR Jev 为每次识别打分并帮助筛选更优候选。
items.reason: 社区开发者用三个 MiniCPM 模型搭出本地记账 Agent，可演示它把 COCONUT JELLY 误读后自检纠错的过程。

Let's forge LEGEND like it's worth a billion dollars. 💀 Full prompt below — steal it! 👇 Extreme cinematic close-up of molten gold pouring through a dark ancient forge. The camera follows the glowing metal through channels at hyperspeed before emerging into an enormous underground chamber. Rivers of molten gold converge at the center and erupt upward like a reverse waterfall. The liquid metal begins sculpting gigantic letters in midair, progressively forming the word “LEGEND.” As each letter solidifies, its surface transitions from incandescent liquid to polished engraved gold. The camera performs a majestic orbit while enormous sparks rain through the chamber. On the final beat, a hammer-like shockwave hits the ground and illuminates the entire golden word. Premium lu
